content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，大家欢迎来到英语有声。我的名字是Marco。

content.text: My name is Catherine and today we have an intermediate level lesson all about cell phones.
content.trans: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们将进行一次中级课程，主题是关于手机。

content.text: That's right. We're going to be buying a cell phone or also known as a mobile phone.
content.trans: 正确。我们要买一部手机，也就是常说的移动电话。

content.text: So before we jump into the dialogue, let's take a look at a specific type of phone on vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 所以，在我们进入对话之前，让我们先看一下词汇预览中的一种特定类型的手机。

content.text: Vocabulary preview. Well the name of this phone is kind of funny. It's called a smart phone.
content.trans: 英语：词汇预览。这个手机的名字有点搞笑。它叫智能手机。

content.text: It's very popular these days, things like the Apple iPhone or the HTC hero. These are examples of a smartphone.
content.trans: 这些天非常流行，比如苹果的iPhone或HTC的英雄。这些都是智能手机的例子。

content.text: That's right. So basically a smartphone has additional functions more than just a normal mobile phone.
content.trans: 正确。所以，基本上来说，智能手机除了基本的手机功能之外，还具有更多的附加功能。

content.text: For example, you can check your email on a smartphone.
content.trans: 例如，你可以用智能手机查看你的电子邮件。

content.text: Yeah. So the thing that makes a smartphone different from a normal mobile phone is that it's like a small computer.
content.trans: 好的。所以，智能手机与普通手机的不同之处在于它像一个小电脑一样。

content.text: You can do things like, like Marco said, send emails or take photos, edit photos, use applications, things like that from your phone.
content.trans: 你可以像马可说的那样，从你的手机发送电子邮件或拍照，编辑照片，使用应用程序，等等。

content.text: Okay. So we're going to be talking about smart phones so let's listen to the dialogue for the first time.
content.trans: 好的。所以我们要讨论的是智能手机，让我们第一次聆听对话吧。

content.text: Hello, sir. May I help you? Yeah. I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet.
content.trans: 你好，先生。你能帮我吗？是的。我意外把手机掉进了马桶里。

content.text: I see. Well, you've come to the right place. We have over 100 models of more than 20 leading mobile phone manufacturers.
content.trans: 我明白了。你来对地方了。我们有超过一百款，来自二十多家领先手机制造商的产品。

content.text: Sounds good. I don't want it to be too expensive. Maybe something mid-range.
content.trans: 听起来不错。我不想它太贵。也许中等价位的吧。

content.text: We have this new HTC smartphone. It comes with the Android OS so you can download applications.
content.trans: 我们有了这款新的HTC智能手机。它搭载了Android操作系统，你可以下载应用程序。

content.text: It also has a built-in camera, MP3 player and touch screen. It works on the 3G network so you have fast access to the internet wherever you are.
content.trans: 它还内置了一部相机、MP3播放器和触摸屏。由于使用了3G网络，你可以随时随地访问互联网。

content.text: What about Wi-Fi? Of course. You can access the internet from any hotspot as well as from home.
content.trans: 关于Wi-Fi？当然。你也可以从任何热点访问互联网，包括在家。

content.text: One last thing. Is it waterproof?
content.trans: 最后一件事。防水吗？

content.text: All right, we're back. Now, have you ever done this? Have you ever dropped your phone in the water?
content.trans: 好的，我们又回来了。你有没有试过把手机掉进水里？

content.text: Have you ever damaged the phone like that? Luckily, no. I'm not calm wood, but I have a good friend who dropped his in the toilet and had to buy a new one.
content.trans: 你有没有把手机摔得像那样？幸运的是，没有。我不是冷静的木头，但我有一个好朋友不小心把他的手机掉进马桶里了，不得不买一个新的。

content.text: Yeah, so this is not made up. It's actually more common than what people think. But we'll get to that in a bit.
content.trans: 是的，所以这并不是胡编乱造。实际上比人们认为的要常见得多。但接下来我们再聊这个。

content.text: Why don't we take a look at five key words in language takeaway?
content.trans: 为什么我们不看看语言取货的五个关键单词？

content.text: Language takeaway. This first word is very important because in this particular dialogue, we're talking about the HTC smartphone.
content.trans: 英语：语言取舍。这个第一个词非常重要，因为在这一特定的对话中，我们谈论的是HTC智能手机。

content.text: This is a special kind of phone and it has an Android operating system or OS. So Android is something that Google came up with.
content.trans: 这是一个特殊的手机，它使用的是安卓操作系统或者操作系统。因此，安卓是谷歌开发出来的。

content.text: And they have this operating system that they're giving away for free. If you want to use it, you can use it.
content.trans: 而且他们免费提供这个操作系统。如果你想使用它，你可以使用它。

content.text: You can make a whole new phone using this operating system. So the operating system like Windows or what's the map one called?
content.trans: 你可以用这个操作系统制作出一台全新的手机。所以，像Windows那样的操作系统叫什么名字？

content.text: Tiger OS. Tiger OS.
content.trans: 傻瓜相机。傻瓜相机。

content.text: You have these. Linux. Yeah, Linux. These are like the interface that allows you to use your computer and interact with it.
content.trans:
你有这些。Linux。是的，Linux。这些都是让你用电脑和与它互动的界面。

（请注意：这里只输出简体中文翻译结果）

content.text: And so they're different for different kinds of computers. But the same is true of a smartphone.
content.trans: 而且，对于不同的种类的电脑来说是不一样的。但是智能手机的情况也是如此。

content.text: Exactly. So that's what we're looking at today. If you see this word Android, it's a proper noun. And as Catherine mentioned, it's the name of the OS or operating system developed by Google.
content.trans: 确实。这就是我们今天要讨论的内容。如果你看到这个词“Android”，那是专有名词。而Catherine提到，它是指谷歌开发的操作系统或操作系统。

content.text: So we're taking a look at a smartphone that uses the Android OS. All right. Now this phone not only carried this operating system, but also an MP3 player.
content.trans: 所以，我们正在查看一款使用Android操作系统的智能手机。好的。这款手机不仅携带了这个操作系统，还配备了MP3播放器。

content.text: That's right. So an MP3 player is a device that plays songs for you. So songs can be stored as MP3s.
content.trans: 正确。所以MP3播放器是一种可以为你播放歌曲的设备。因此，歌曲也可以以MP3格式存储。

content.text: A good example of an MP3 player is an iPod. An iPod exactly. And for many of you, you're listening to this podcast as an MP3 file through an MP3 player. So that's a name we usually say MP3.
content.trans: 一个典型的MP3播放器的例子就是iPod。iPod就是这样。对于你们中的许多人来说，你正在通过MP3播放器听这个播客节目。所以，我们通常说的MP3就是这个名字。

content.text: Exactly. And another feature of this special smartphone is that you can use it on the 3G network. What is a 3G network?
content.trans: Exactly. 这款特殊智能手机的另一个特点是，你可以在3G网络上使用它。什么是3G网络？

content.text: All right. So a 3G network is a third generation network, which allows more information to be sent. So not only can you send voice like a normal
content.trans: 好的。所以，3G网络是一种第三代网络，可以发送更多的信息。因此，除了能像普通手机一样发送语音外，你还能够发送其他类型的信息。

content.text: cell phone network, but now you can send pictures or you can download information like, for example, your email. So this is a new 3G network.
content.trans: 手机网络，但现在你可以发送图片或下载信息，例如你的电子邮件。所以这是一个新的3G网络。

content.text: It allows you to send more information, more data. Exactly. 3G, third generation.
content.trans: 它允许你发送更多信息，更多数据。确切地说，这是第三代网络。

content.text: And in addition to this, our customer wants to know about Wi-Fi. Okay. Wi-Fi, you hear this a lot when you go to a hotel or a restaurant. They say we have Wi-Fi access.
content.trans: 而且，我们的客户还想知道关于Wi-Fi的事情。当你去酒店或餐馆时，你经常会听到这个词。他们说我们有Wi-Fi接入。

content.text: Right. And Wi-Fi stands for wireless fidelity. So it's basically internet that has no wires. You don't need to connect your computer to anything. You just log on and use the internet.
content.trans: 好的。Wi-Fi 简称无线保真，也就是说它实际上就是没有电线的互联网。你不需要将电脑连接到任何东西上，只需登录并使用互联网即可。

content.text: All right. So look out for that when you're in a cafe next time. Do they have Wi-Fi? Usually there's a sign on the wall.
content.trans: 好的。下次你在咖啡馆里时，注意看那个标志。他们有Wi-Fi吗？通常在墙上会有标识。

content.text: And finally, this customer wants to know, is this great phone waterproof? What is waterproof?
content.trans: 最后，这位顾客想知道，这款手机防水吗？什么是防水？

content.text: All right. So if you have a watch, for example, and you can take this watch into a swimming pool or the ocean, it means it's waterproof. So it resists water. It won't get damaged if it gets wet.
content.trans: 好的。比如说，如果你有一块手表，并且你可以将这块手表带进游泳池或海洋中，那么这意味着它防水了。所以即使手表被水浸湿，也不会损坏。

content.text: Great. So I could say that I have a waterproof jacket. Right. So that means that when I go in the rain, my clothes don't get wet because they don't go inside the fabric.
content.trans: 好的。所以我说我有一件防水夹克，对吗？也就是说，当我下雨的时候，我的衣服不会湿，因为它们没有进入夹克的面料里。

content.text: Right. So and there are many things waterproof as watches or waterproof cameras. I've never really seen a waterproof mobile phone though. I think that's a good invention. Maybe that would be.
content.trans: 好的。所以和那里有很多防水的，比如手表或者防水相机。我从来没有见过一款真正的防水手机。我认为那是一个好发明。也许那就是。

content.text: All right. So those are five key words for language takeaway. Why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back.
content.trans: 好的。所以这些就是五个关键词汇，让我们再次聆听对话，并在回来之前做好准备。

content.text: Hello, sir. May I help you? Yeah. I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet.
content.trans: 你好，先生。你能帮我吗？是的。我意外把手机掉进了马桶里。

content.text: I see. Well, you've come to the right place. We have over 100 models of more than 20 leading mobile phone manufacturers.
content.trans: 我明白了。你来对地方了。我们有超过一百款，来自二十多家领先手机制造商的产品。

content.text: Sounds good. I don't want it to be too expensive. Maybe something mid-range.
content.trans: 听起来不错。我不想它太贵。也许中等价位的吧。

content.text: We have this new HTC smartphone. It comes with the Android OS so you can download applications. It also has a built-in camera, MP3 player, and touch screen.
content.trans: 我们有了这款新的HTC智能手机。它配备了Android操作系统，你可以下载应用程序。此外，它还内置了摄像头、MP3播放器和触摸屏。

content.text: It works on the 3G network so you have fast access to the internet wherever you are. What about Wi-Fi?
content.trans: 它在3G网络上工作，所以你可以随时随地访问互联网。WiFi呢？

content.text: Of course. You can access the internet from any hotspot as well as from home. One last thing. Is it waterproof?
content.trans: 当然。你可以在任何热点或家中上网。最后一件事，防水吗？

content.text: All right. We're back. So now we have three phrases for you on Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 好的。我们回来了。现在，你将有三个短语供你在“流利 builder”中使用。

content.text: Fluency Builder. Okay. This first phrase is a way of expressing something. So we're going to give you a
content.trans: 英语：流利者训练器。好的。这个第一个短语是一种表达方式。所以我们要给你一个

content.text: formula. The first word is leading. So leading mobile phone manufacturers. So when we use the word leading, we're saying that it's leading in industry.
content.trans: 英语：公式。第一个词是“领先”。所以，像领先的手机制造商一样。当我们用到“领先”这个词时，我们是在说它在行业里处于领先地位。

content.text: That means the most important manufacturers in a kind of industry. Right. So it's one of the biggest is one of the best.
content.trans: 这意味着该行业最重要的一些制造商。对了，它之一是其中之一。

content.text: And if we want to change the noun, we can say for example, the leading car manufacturer.
content.trans: 并且如果我们想要改变这个名词，我们可以例如说，领先的汽车制造商。

content.text: Exactly. So in Japan, I wonder who the leading car manufacturer is. Is it Toyota? Toyota.
content.trans: 的确。在日本，我想知道谁是领先的汽车制造商。是丰田吗？丰田。

content.text: And we could also say that about clothing. The leading clothing manufacturer in America is I have no idea about cotton.
content.trans: 而且我们也可以这么说关于衣服。美国的领带制造商我也不知道是用什么做的棉。

content.text: Cotton, right? So you can use many other nouns. And well, if you want to drop the manufacturers, you can say the leading brand in cosmetics or the leading supplier of medical equipment.
content.trans: 棉花，对吧？所以你可以用其他名词。而且如果你想要撇清制造商的话，可以说化妆品领域的领头品牌或者医疗设备的领先供应商。

content.text: So this means the person or the company with the most that's the most important in an industry.
content.trans: 所以这意味着这个行业中最重要的人或公司。

content.text: Right. And going back to one of the features of the mobile phone, we talked about the built-in camera. Now this structure is interesting. Built in.
content.trans: 好的。回到手机的一个功能，我们提到过内置的相机。这个结构很有趣。内置。

content.text: Well, we can say that things are built in when they are a part of something else. For example, a built-in camera is a part of a phone. It's not a camera and a phone.
content.trans: 好的，我们可以这样说，当它们成为某物的一部分时，事情就被构建起来了。例如，内置的相机是手机的一部分。它既不是相机也不是手机。

content.text: Two different devices. They're put together. We can also say this about cabinets.
content.trans: 两种不同的设备。它们组合在一起。我们也可以这样描述橱柜。

content.text: You know, you can buy cabinets and you can put them in your house and keep things in them. But we often have built-ins. That means that they're stuck on the wall. You can't take them away.
content.trans: 你懂的，你可以买个柜子放在家里，然后把东西放进去。但很多时候我们都有嵌入式的东西。这意味着它们被固定在墙上，你不能拿下来。

content.text: Those are called built-ins because they're part of the wall. So built-in camera is a part of the phone.
content.trans: 那些被称为内置设备，因为它们是墙壁的一部分。所以内置相机就是手机的一部分。

content.text: Right. So you can pretty much use this structure with two products that are combined as one. For example, the cabinets that Catherine mentioned or
content.trans: 好的。你可以用这种结构与两个产品组合在一起的情况结合起来使用。例如，Catherine提到的橱柜。

content.text: if your refrigerator has a television incorporated, right, you can say this refrigerator comes with a built-in television.
content.trans: 如果你的冰箱里装有电视，对吧，你可以这样描述你的冰箱：它自带了一台内置电视。

content.text: Or very common is the laptop with built-in speakers. So that means we don't have to bring speakers with us every time we want to use the laptop.
content.trans: 或者最常见的笔记本电脑配备内置扬声器，这意味着我们不需要每次使用笔记本时都带着扬声器。

content.text: There's small speakers inside the refrigerator. Right. Very good. And we have one last phrase.
content.trans: 冰箱里有个小扬声器。对，很好。我们还有最后一个词。

content.text: One last phrase. One last thing.
content.trans: 最后的一句话。最后一件事。

content.text: All right. So that's our phrase. One last thing. Oh, before you go, one last thing.
content.trans: 好的。这就是我们的短语。最后一件事。在你离开之前，还有一个最后的事。

content.text: So this is often said when someone's leaving a conversation. So I'm going to say, okay, Marco, I've got to go run and do something. I'll see you later.
content.trans: 所以，当某人离开对话时，这常常被说成是。所以我现在要说，好的，Marco，我得去跑跑步或者做点别的事情了。我们稍后见。

content.text: Right. Oh, wait, wait, wait. One last thing. Wait, what? Oh, okay. So now I'll wait.
content.trans: 好的。哦，等等，等等。还有一个最后的事。等等，这是什么？哦，好吧。现在我要等了。

content.text: So one last thing is a way to say, no, wait, hold on. I have to tell you one more thing.
content.trans: 所以最后一件事是，有一种方式来表示，不，等等，稍等一下。我还有一个重要的事情要告诉你。

content.text: So yeah, as you say, you can use it as a fixed phrase. One last thing or before I go, one last thing.
content.trans: 所以，正如你说的那样，你可以把它用作固定短语。最后一件事或在离开之前，最后一件事。

content.text: Can you take out the dog thing we have to talk about? Right. And this was our last word. So why don't we listen to our dialogue for the last time?
content.trans: 你把我们要谈的那只狗的事儿拿出来，好吗？对了。这是我们的最后话。那我们再听一次对话吧。

content.text: Hello, sir. May I help you? Yeah, I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet.
content.trans: 你好，先生。你能帮我吗？是的，我意外把手机掉进了马桶里。

content.text: I see. Well, you've come to the right place. We have over 100 models of more than 20 leading mobile phone manufacturers.
content.trans: 我明白了。你来对地方了。我们有超过一百款，来自二十多家领先手机制造商的产品。

content.text: Sounds good. I don't want it to be too expensive. Maybe something mid-range.
content.trans: 听起来不错。我不想它太贵。也许中等价位的吧。

content.text: We have this new HTC smartphone. It comes with the Android OS so you can download applications.
content.trans: 我们有了这款新的HTC智能手机。它搭载了Android操作系统，你可以下载应用程序。

content.text: It also has a built-in camera, MP3 player and touch screen. It works on the 3G network so you have fast access to the internet wherever you are.
content.trans: 它还内置了一部相机、MP3播放器和触摸屏。由于支持3G网络，您可以在任何地方快速访问互联网。

content.text: What about Wi-Fi? Of course. You can access the internet from any hotspot as well as from home.
content.trans: 关于Wi-Fi？当然。你也可以从任何热点访问互联网，包括家中的网络。

content.text: One last thing. Is it waterproof?
content.trans: 最后一件事。防水吗？

content.text: All right, we're back and I actually read somewhere that many girls have this accident because they placed their mobile phones in their back pockets.
content.trans: 好的，我们又回来了。我实际上是在某处读到，许多女孩因为将手机放在了后口袋里而发生了这种事故。

content.text: So when they go to the bathroom, the phone accidentally drops out and falls into the toilet.
content.trans: 所以，当他们去洗手间时，手机不小心掉进了马桶里。

content.text: I heard a different explanation with this common problem. Maybe not very appropriate.
content.trans: 我听说这个问题的另一种解释是这样的，可能不太合适。

content.text: But boys have this problem because they take their phone to the bathroom and they play with them when they're using the bathroom.
content.trans: 但是男孩们有这样的问题，因为他们把手机带到了卫生间，并在使用卫生间时玩弄它们。

content.text: I've also heard this that you're maybe checking your messages or checking your email when your bathroom falls.
content.trans: 我也听说你可能在上厕所的时候正在看短信或者查看邮件。

content.text: Just falls. Yeah, so I think boys and girls all have this problem. Be careful with your phones.
content.trans: 当然了。嗯，我觉得男生女生都有一样的问题吧。小心你的手机。

content.text: Those smartphones are still pretty expensive. Yes, they are.
content.trans: 那些智能手机仍然很贵。是的，它们是。

content.text: All right, so if you have any questions, any doubts you can contact us at EnglishPod.com.
content.trans: 好的，如果你有任何问题或疑问，请随时联系我们。联系方式是：英语有声网.com。

content.text: And we'll see everyone there. Bye everyone.
content.trans: 我们会见到每个人的。大家再见。
